# Office Toolkit

Office Toolkit is a free, browser-first suite of tools for e-signatures and invoices. No account, no uploads, no data harvesting — your work stays on your device.

## Tools

- **E-Signature Maker** — https://office-toolkit.vercel.app/e-signature-maker
  Draw, type, or upload a signature and place it on any PDF. Download as transparent PNG or signed PDF.

- **Invoice Generator** — https://office-toolkit.vercel.app/invoice-generator
  Create professional invoices with line items, tax, logo, and multiple currencies. Export as PDF, PNG, or JPG.

- **Sign PDF Online** — https://office-toolkit.vercel.app/tools/esignature-for-pdf
  Upload a PDF, add your signature, download the signed copy.

- **Sign Word Document** — https://office-toolkit.vercel.app/tools/esignature-for-word
  Upload a .docx file, place your signature, download a signed PDF.

- **Sign Excel File** — https://office-toolkit.vercel.app/tools/esignature-for-excel
  Add an electronic signature to an .xlsx file without touching the data.

- **Sign Contracts** — https://office-toolkit.vercel.app/tools/esignature-for-contracts
  Multi-party signatures with dates on every page, exported as PDF.

- **Sign Offer Letter** — https://office-toolkit.vercel.app/tools/esignature-for-offer-letter
  Company and candidate signatures with role details, exported as PDF.

- **GST Invoice Generator** — https://office-toolkit.vercel.app/tools/gst-invoice-generator
  GST-compliant invoices with HSN codes, tax breakdown, PDF export.

- **Invoice Format in Excel** — https://office-toolkit.vercel.app/tools/invoice-format-excel
  Free Excel template with auto-calculating totals and GST column.

- **Invoice Format in Word** — https://office-toolkit.vercel.app/tools/invoice-format-word
  Free Word template with logo, item table, GST, and totals.

- **Freelancer Invoice Generator** — https://office-toolkit.vercel.app/tools/invoice-for-freelancers
  Project-based invoices with payment terms, client details, PDF export.

- **Quotation Format** — https://office-toolkit.vercel.app/tools/quotation-format
  Quotation template with validity period, works as proforma invoice.

## Key Facts

- **Free**: All tools are completely free, no hidden charges
- **No signup**: Use immediately without creating an account
- **Local-first**: Everything runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded to any server
- **Export formats**: Invoices → PDF, PNG, JPG | Signatures → PNG, signed PDF
- **Supported currencies**: INR, USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, and more
- **GST ready**: HSN codes, CGST/SGST/IGST breakdown for Indian invoices
